evidence.description: Configured low-voltage failsafe is 10.50 V on a pack observed peaking at 24.52 V (6S). The threshold is unreachable, so the failsafe cannot trigger.
Arming voltage is set to 22.10 V, consistent with a 6S pack — so the low/critical thresholds are the outliers, not the pack.

notes: Sag detection for this flight used the inferred 6S pack from a 24.52 V peak instead.
Set BATT_LOW_VOLT and BATT_CRT_VOLT for the installed pack; until then the vehicle has no effective battery failsafe.
